rules.title: One per user-facing change
rules.text: Add a changeset with changeset add for every PR that changes published code.

rules.title: Default to patch
rules.text: Default to patch. Choose minor or major only when the change warrants it and the maintainers agree.

rules.title: Write for users
rules.text: Write the summary for users of the package: what was broken or added and how it behaves now.

rules.title: Skip internal changes
rules.text: Tests, CI and docs-only changes do not need a changeset.

rules.title: Skip unpublished packages
rules.text: Do not select examples or private packages in a changeset.

rules.title: ignore is temporary
rules.text: Use the ignore option only temporarily. Mark a package private: true to stop publishing it for good.

rules.title: Release from CI
rules.text: Run changeset version in a release PR and changeset publish from CI, not from a laptop.
